lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The high-luminance circular clusters are organized into roughly parallel vertical columns, with approximately four to five spots per column visible in the mid-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of the circular spots, creating a distinct nodal grid pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side transitioning to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin's silhouette exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots concentrated toward the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct fusiform silhouettes, identified as commensal remoras, are visible in the ventral water column beneath the pectoral fin area.
